title: Show HN: Edi Life OS – self-hosted life dashboard with an MCP server for AI
script:
Edris Ranjbar released Edi Life OS on GitHub.
The project is a self-hosted life dashboard.
It features an MCP server for artificial intelligence.
The code is available publicly online now.
Would you install this dashboard for your daily routine?
